stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.description: Re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, Advance roll, Charge roll, Desperate Escape test, or Hazard test.

stratagems.name: Counter-Offensive
stratagems.description: Interrupt the combat sequence immediately after an enemy unit has fought to fight with one eligible unit from your army.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.description: Your unit can arrive from Reserves as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, during your opponent's turn.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.description: Declare a counter-charge with one eligible unit after an enemy unit completes a charge move within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range after completing a Charge move; roll dice equal to your vehicle toughness and inflict mortal wounds on 5+.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within 8" and visible to this unit; roll six D6, each 4+ causes 1 mortal wound.

abilities.name: For the Khan!
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability and melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.

abilities.name: Trophy Taker
abilities.description: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character model, you gain 1CP

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This model can be attached to the following units: ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SQUAD, ASSAULT SQUAD, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, COMMAND SQUAD, COMPANY HEROES, INTERCESSOR SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, TACTICAL SQUAD, VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD

abilities.name: Inspiring Commander
abilities.description: If you include this model in your army, until the end of the battle, non-Character models in Outrider Squad units from your army have an Objective Control characteristic of 3 while they are not Battle-shocked.

abilities.name: Spear of Chogoris
abilities.description: This model’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. If that unit is already eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit instead.

abilities.name: Skilled Riders
abilities.description: Each time a model in this model’s unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This model can be attached to the following units: BIKE SQUAD, COMPANY VETERANS ON BIKES, OUTRIDER SQUAD
